transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to complete in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Before I sign off on the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Let's start with the training NCO — what's the status on forklift-operator certification? Then motor pool sergeant on the generator refresher, and safety officer on the hazmat refresher. I also need to know if there are any facility or safety constraints I should be aware of for the training room, motor pool training bay, or safety classroom.
